sentences.text: Cathartornis is an extinct genus of bird belonging to the family Teratornithidae.
The only known fossils consist of two tarsometatarsi, one complete and one partial.
Fossils were found in Late Pleistocene deposits at the La Brea Tar Pits in Southern California.
No additional fossils have been assigned to Cathartornis, though some remains previously classified as Teratornis might belong to this genus.
Unpublished fossil material has been mentioned in connection with the genus Cathartornis.
Cathartornis lived during the Late Pleistocene, between 0.129 and 0.0117 million years ago.
